notes.title: AudioBeat's first update in 2017, thank you for your support!
notes.notes:
Update content:

1) Game play: improve interactions, include hit reaction, sound fx.
2) Content: Add 6 songs of different styles.
3) Features: Leader board support. You can see the highest three score/player of the song, and your own rank as well.
4) Hardware: Oculus Rift CV1 support.Oculus Touch needed.
5) Other: Some Bugs fixed.

AudioBeat's R & D team wish you have a happy Spring Festival!
